before.identity_note: Previously measured profiling runtime, subsequently committed as 713bd3e1 after test-module relocation. This is not an a9da6e87 build.

after.identity_note: Uncommitted public SQL snapshot integration on this base; exact source hashes identify measured implementation.

fixture.digest_format: generation-order u64be path-length/path/u64be byte-length/bytes; excludes manifest

method.cache: Existing schema-22 cache with 10000 local record payloads; no refresh, rebuild, or source fallback in measured requests.
method.timed: Permission resolution, shared query service, compact JSON serialization.
method.excluded: Cargo compilation, process/test startup, request file parsing, independent result oracle, diagnostic printing, external fixture digest validation.
method.oracle: Exact total and ordered paths; at most 50 rows, no body, empty diagnostics, serialized output <=256KiB.
method.fixture_verified: Full payload digest and membership match before baseline, after release build, and after final run.
method.identities_verified: Both executables and all six after source hashes verified after final run.
method.overlap: Eight qualifying runs serialized with no concurrent Cargo jobs or fixture verification. Separate initial overlapping attempt excluded below.
method.quantiles: Nearest rank; median arithmetic middle pair. First request in each run excluded from repeated summaries.

limitations: Diagnostic only; not a reference-host acceptance test or controlled comparison against previous CLI runs.

Only 10K fixture, one first request and nine varied repeated requests per run, two runs per scope/build; no 1000-sample, concurrency, throughput, memory-growth, 100K, cold-cache, rebuild, or write gates.
OS pages warmed by fixture verification; power/frequency/background load uncontrolled.
Nested stage durations overlap their parents and must not all be summed.

Completed manifest counters exclude partially failed scans. Refresh and fallback internals have timings/attempt counts only. No complete syscall, source-read, CEL/schema compilation, or candidate accounting.
App benchmark is a test executable with default production core dependency; process startup excluded.
This comparison includes conservative SQL preparation plus public integration versus the older profiling runtime, not solely the final integration patch.
Before and after runs show host/order variation; aggregate after timings are slower. No speedup or unreachability is established.
SQLite/decode stage now includes scalar consistency serialization, so its stage boundary differs from the baseline.
Candidate pruning still prepares complete input bindings, hydrates every visible record and reconciles all sources. No property index/selective hydration claim.
